$comment: Shipwright upgrades (PRD section 7; slice 5 of docs/design/combat-model.md): installed for good, one of each per ship, each with a cost besides gold so none is strictly better. Modifiers: speed adds speed points (negative for weight); upwindDeg lets her sail that many degrees closer to the wind; the *Mult fields multiply crew berths, hull, gun range (round and grape) and reload time; swivels mounts swivel guns; oars rows her at that share of her top speed (sweeps), at a slower reload while she rows; nettings stiffen her when boarded and slow her own boarders a little; cleanBottom keeps her from fouling; sailWear multiplies the harm to her canvas; overheats slows her reload after three quick broadsides; spoilsDays is how long before it is spent and must be bought again. sizes: the settlement sizes whose shipwright sells it. price is what it costs for the 'priceFor' class (the brig, the starting ship); other classes pay by the work, 'per' gun, hull point or berth against the brig's, rounded to 10 gold. The shipwright's row shows the upside and the downside. Era availability waits for eras.

upgrades.name: Triple hammocks
upgrades.effect: +25% crew berths · more men to feed and pay

upgrades.name: Cotton sails
upgrades.effect: Sails 8 degrees closer to the wind · tear sooner

upgrades.name: Bronze cannon
upgrades.effect: Reload 20% faster, +10% range · overheat after three quick broadsides

upgrades.name: Swivel guns
upgrades.effect: 4 swivels sweep a deck close in · -5% berths

upgrades.name: Boarding nettings
upgrades.effect: Boarders repelled: +40% when boarded · -10% going over

upgrades.name: Sweeps
upgrades.effect: Row at a fifth of her speed in a calm · reload slower while rowing
